title: Participate
subtitle: Experimental Study on Cooperative Social Interactions, Cognition, and Brain Activity
intro: Thank you for your interest in participating in our study! As part of this research, you will need to sign up with a friend who will be your partner throughout your experimental session.

studyDetails.venue: Human Performance Lab, Level 3, Sunway University

eligibility.intro: For the older adult group, participants should be:
items: Free from a severe head injury or a diagnosed neurological condition
Have normal or corrected vision and hearing
Not taking any neurologically active medication
eligibility.partnerNote: Your partner needs to meet the same criteria.

partnerSection: Social interaction is central to this research, so we ask you to sign up with a partner rather than assigning one for you. You're welcome to bring anyone you already have a relationship with — a friend, relative, or spouse — as long as they also meet the eligibility criteria above.
compensation: RM 30 Grab voucher per person for each lab session
Top performers on cognitive games can win an additional RM100 Grab voucher per person

timeline.note: The entire programme consists of two lab sessions and a 2-week intervention at home.
steps: First lab session: Pre-test for EEG and cognitive assessment baseline measures
2-week intervention: Play online cognitive games at home
Second lab session: Post-test for EEG and cognitive assessment baseline measures

notes: Even though you are required to sign up as a pair, you may be randomly assigned to play the cognitive games individually throughout the study.
This study consists of a 2 week-long intervention period at home. However, it is not a long-term programme.
confidentiality: All data collected is handled confidentially. It is not linked to personally identifiable information, and it's stored in password-protected folders and locked facilities.
